g.text: 1. evidence_use - : ID used in the current turn
3. consideration - : Model's rationale for the selected action
4. action -> -- move / explore / question / prepare / accuse / pass
Question -- Target : ID of the target in the same room
Accuse -- Suspect : Suspect ID in the candidate list
-- Weapon : Weapon ID in the candidate list
-- Place : Place ID in the candidate list
When receive a question from another agent
3. consideration -- : Model's rationale for the selected action
4. information_policy SHARE_FULL -- Disclose all held clues
SHARE_PARTIAL -- Disclose some of the held clues
NOTHING_TO_SHARE -- Unable to disclose cuz no clues are held
10. occupants Other Agent+NPC in same room X
12. positions Loc Info in the Movement Phase X
9. occupants Ohter Agent+NPC in same room

g.text: 3. agent_id Agent who submitted the action
5. task_id Task number issued by GM
8. phase_epoch Sequence number within the phase
9. execution_status Whether the engine processed it
11. consumed Whether the action was spent
12. action Name of the action performed
13. room Agent's room after the action
15. target_id Who was targeted, else None
18. held_information_ids All clue IDs currently held
